Clause 4.2
Notice
A written termination notice must be delivered 30 days before the service ends.

Clause 4.3
Renewal
A renewal request must be delivered 60 days before the agreement expires.

Clause 5.1
Refund
Approved refunds are paid within 14 days after approval.

Clause 5.2
Appeal
An appeal must be filed within 7 days after a decision.

Clause 6.1
Backup
Encrypted backups are retained for 90 days.

Clause 6.2
Restore
A backup restore requires approval from the incident manager.

Clause 7.1
Password
Account passwords must contain at least 12 characters.

Clause 7.2
Rotation
API key rotation is required every 45 days.

Clause 8.1
Travel
Travel expenses must be submitted with receipts within 21 days.

Clause 8.2
Leave
Annual leave requests require approval from the line manager.

Clause 9.1
Access
Guest access expires after 48 hours.

Clause 9.2
Deletion
Personal data deletion requests are completed within 28 days.

Clause 10.1
Warranty
Hardware warranty coverage lasts 24 months.

Clause 10.2
Support
Priority support is available between 08:00 and 18:00 UTC.

Clause 11.1
Onboarding
New employee onboarding includes mandatory safety training.

Clause 11.2
Shipping
Replacement equipment is shipped within 3 business days.
